judge.reason: The note's forcing line is unsound because after ...Re1+ White can simply play Kf2 (d1 is still occupied by White's own rook so d2 cannot promote), refuting the claimed 'Kf2 loses to d1=Q+' and the whole Rxf1+ combination, making the central tactical claim false even though the generic advice to look for forcing checks on a tied-down piece is a reasonable but vague takeaway.
